modern_c2_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    girl_patches = image_patch.find("girl")
    headband_patches = image_patch.find("headband")
    
    if not girl_patches or not headband_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    girl_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in girl_patches]
    headband_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in headband_patches]
    
    closest_headband = min(headband_centers, key=lambda h: min(abs(h[0] - g[0]) for g in girl_centers))
    closest_headband_patch = next(p for p in headband_patches if (p.left + p.right) / 2 == closest_headband[0] and (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 == closest_headband[1])
    
    return closest_headband_patch

def answer_query(image, query):
    # Create an ImagePatch object
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Find patches of objects in the image
    object_patches = image_patch.find(query)

    # If no patches are found, return a message
    if not object_patches:
        return f"No {query} found in the image."

    # Sort patches by y-coordinate (assuming patches are in top-down order)
    object_patches.sort(key=lambda patch: (patch.upper + patch.lower) / 2)

    # Return the patch on the end (with the highest y-coordinate)
    end_patch = object_patches[-1]

    # If the query is "boy on end", return the name of the boy
    if query == "boy":
        boy_name = end_patch.simple_query("What is the name of the boy?")
        return f"The boy on the end is {boy_name}."
    else:
        return f"The {query} on the end is at coordinates ({end_patch.left}, {end_patch.lower}, {end_patch.right}, {end_patch.upper})."
